title: Mandol — paper view
subtitle: The mechanism as Zhang et al. describe it. Lane = canonical stage (METHODOLOGY-SKELETON §2.2); A6 and B8 are empty because the paper defines no such step.
source: Zhang et al. 2026, Mandol (arXiv:2606.29778v1)   ·   every anchor re-located in the paper text during verification (servers/mandol/verification.md §3)
legend_notes: B5 SELECT is drawn as three internal stages of one mechanism (Eq.1 MAD denoising → Eq.2 cross-source conflict arbitration → Eq.3 token-constrained MMR) — the paper presents this as one cascading pipeline, and the code's CascadeConfidencePruner implements exactly this three-stage structure, hence one canonical name Fusion:Cascade for all three.

A6 INTERNALIZE and B8 LOOP are both empty: nothing is trained into parameters, and retrieval is stated to be entirely LLM-free with no query-time tool loop (abstract txt:31-33, §1 txt:110-112, §3.3 txt:459).
The paper claims four memory sources (basic/episodic/semantic/emotional) — all four are drawn here as the paper states them; the code view shows only three ever produce evidence.
P13's persistence backend is drawn exactly as the paper states it (DuckDB) — the diff view shows this backend does not exist anywhere in the implementation.
